PVC warning, >=10-year durability, UV/bee qualification, CO₂/light conditions, nursery/graft roles, source-specific pF direction/ranges/inclusive thresholds/sustained condition, >=2-year woody and herbaceous definition, 2021 historical statistics, fruit ripening and flower cold chain checked. numericExceptions.reason: 二号資料 in the Japanese source is the level-2 source label. Vietnamese Tài liệu 2号 expresses the identical source qualification using an Arabic digit; no quantity or scope changed.
The source title 炭酸ガス denotes carbon dioxide; Vietnamese CO₂ is the same chemical formula. Its subscript 2 is molecular notation, not an added quantity.
The source objective mentions 二酸化炭素 and its possible daytime deficiency in a closed facility. Vietnamese names it CO₂ twice to keep the subject clear; both subscript digits are molecular notation.
The source activity lists light, 二酸化炭素 and the supply device. CO₂ names that same gas; the subscript is not an extra operating value.
The source equates 炭酸ガス with 二酸化炭素. The two Vietnamese CO₂ occurrences explicitly identify the same substance in that equivalence and photosynthesis explanation; the digits are formula subscripts.
The source links light conditions to 二酸化炭素 in photosynthesis when light is present. Vietnamese CO₂ denotes the same gas without changing any condition; the 2 is a formula subscript.

The source describes possible 二酸化炭素 deficiency in a facility closed during daytime and distinguishes good outdoor weather from sufficient indoor gas. The two CO₂ subscripts preserve the same gas references, not numeric amounts.
The source describes a 炭酸ガス発生装置 supplying 二酸化炭素 to promote photosynthesis. Vietnamese uses thiết bị tạo CO₂ and then khí này; its subscript identifies the same gas, not a concentration.
The source warns that increasing 二酸化炭素 is not a guarantee of better growth under every condition. Vietnamese CO₂ preserves this gas and the negation; its 2 is molecular notation.

The source lists 二酸化炭素 among temperature, humidity and light in integrated environment control. Vietnamese CO₂ denotes that same environmental gas; its subscript 2 is chemical notation, not a new numerical control condition.

The source CA-storage paragraph says to lower oxygen and raise 二酸化炭素 in addition to cooling. Vietnamese CO₂ names the same gas and retains the direction of adjustment; the subscript is not a storage setting.
